messages.text:
Hi Diego — could we meet for 30 minutes on **Wednesday 25 November at 10:00**, in my office?

I had meant this week's Wednesday at 10:00, but that hour has already passed today (it's just after 11:00), so let's aim for next week. The department tells me your CSE451 lecture at that hour is cancelled this week, so 10:00 shouldn't clash with teaching even if your calendar still shows the class.

Please put it in your calendar and confirm — and tell me if a different slot suits you better.

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks, but I have to flag a mix-up on the date.

I do teach CSE451 at 10:00 on Wednesdays, and the cancellation you heard about is only for *this* week (today). On Wednesday 25 November the class is still on, so 10:00 that day doesn't work for me — I'd be lecturing, and grading follows at 11:00 until 12:30.

Could we do Wednesday 25 November at 12:30, 13:00, or 15:00 instead? Any of those half hours is free for me, and I'd be glad to come to your office. Just say which one and I'll put it in.

My apologies, Diego — I had the cancellation down as applying to the whole week; you're right, it's today's lecture only.

Let's take **Wednesday 25 November at 13:00** — that gives you a little room after grading and we're done by 13:30. My office, as usual. Please put it in and confirm.

No problem at all — thank you for accommodating.

Confirmed: **Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30, your office**. It's in my calendar; it sits nicely right after grading and before my 14:00 1:1. See you then.
One more thing: I'll have the room booked and coffee ready. See you then.
Perfect — thank you, Diego. Bring the current chapter draft if it's ready.
Will do — I'll bring the chapter draft along. See you Wednesday at 13:00.
